scientific_integrity: Exact finite group computation supplemented by transparent classical geometric transfer and published realizability. Known 27-line, 45-tritangent and 25-class counts credited.
scientific_limitations: Weyl-class reconstruction only; no curve-equation or surface-isomorphism reconstruction. Optimality over actual surfaces is guaranteed for all sufficiently large q, not every small q. Equivalence to earlier unindexed cycle-index work cannot be excluded.
title: Three-extension recovery of cubic-surface Frobenius from lines and tritangent planes
